annotations.title: Add a picture to an UpFork article

description: Adds a picture to the user's article from its https address (UpFork fetches it: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, 5 MB at most). Answers with the Markdown line to put in the text, and its id for the cover. Use pictures the user may publish. Name the model writing in model, as you name yourself ("Claude Opus 5.5"): the article tells its readers it was written with it.

cover.description: true to make it the article's cover as well.

model.description: The AI model writing, as it names itself.

name: add_article_image

id.description: Give it to update_article as cover to make it the cover.

markdown.description: Put this line in the text where the picture goes, with words that describe it.
